story.asA: user who has not yet verified their email
story.iWant: to be able to request a new verification email
story.soThat: I can complete my account registration if the original email was lost or delayed.
story.tasks: - Task 1: Create a UI component or page state for an unverified user, which includes the "Resend Verification Email" button. (AC: 1) - Task 2: Implement the `resendVerification` method in the `AuthManager` service to call the appropriate Supabase auth method. (AC: 2) - Task 3: Connect the button's onClick event to the `AuthManager.resendVerification` method, including logic to disable the button and show a loading state during the API call. (AC: 2) - Task 4: Implement a success toast notification to inform the user that a new email has been sent. (AC: 4) - Task 5: Write a unit test for the `AuthManager.resendVerification` method, mocking the Supabase client. - Task 6: Write a component test for the UI state for unverified users, verifying the button's presence and behavior.

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: - AC 1: Given I am on a page that informs me my email is unverified (e.g., after a failed login attempt), Then a "Resend Verification Email" button or link must be clearly visible. - AC 2: Given I click the "Resend Verification Email" button, When the action is triggered, Then the client-side `AuthManager.resendVerification(email)` function must be invoked with my email address. - AC 3: Given the `resendVerification` call to Supabase is successful, When I check my email inbox, Then I must find a new verification email from the application. - AC 4: Given I have requested to resend the verification email, When the UI updates, Then a non-intrusive toast notification must appear, stating "A new verification email has been sent." - AC 5: Given I click the link in the newly received email, Then my account must be successfully verified, as per the flow defined in `story-1-002`.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: User Authentication & Onboarding
doc.snippet: The `AuthManager` module will expose methods that wrap Supabase calls, including `resendVerification(email: string): Promise<{ error }>;`.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: User Authentication & Onboarding
doc.snippet: Email delivery for verification and password resets depends on the underlying email provider configured in Supabase. The system should include a "Resend Verification" feature as a fallback.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: User Authentication & Onboarding
doc.snippet: AC3: A user who has not verified their email is shown an option to resend the verification email.

doc.title: UX Design Specification
doc.snippet: Non-intrusive "toast" notifications will be used. They will appear for 3-4 seconds and then fade automatically to confirm a successful action.

story-context.constraints: - The implementation must use the appropriate `resend` method from the `@supabase/supabase-js` client library. - The "Resend" button should be disabled and show a loading spinner while the API call is in progress. - A success toast notification must be displayed on successful API response. - The feature depends on a UI state that recognizes an unverified user, likely stemming from a failed login attempt.

tests.standards: Use testing frameworks like Cypress or Playwright for E2E tests. Create unit tests for services and component tests for UI elements.
tests.locations: - Unit/Service Tests: `src/services/__tests__/` - Component Tests: `src/components/__tests__/` - E2E Tests: `cypress/e2e/`
tests.ideas: - (AC1, 2) Integration test: attempt login with unverified user, see the "Resend" button, click it, and verify the `AuthManager` method is called. - (AC3) E2E test: mock the Supabase resend call and verify that a new (mocked) email is "sent". - (AC4) Component test the display of the success toast notification after the button is clicked.
